page.overview:
Who is Chicken?

The (Gallus gallus domesticus or Gallus domesticus) is a large and round short-winged bird, domesticated from the (Gallus gallus) of Southeast Asia around 8,000 years ago. Most chickens are raised for food, providing meat and eggs; others are kept as pets or for cockfighting.

Chickens are common and widespread domestic animals, with a total population of 26.5 billion as of 2023, and an annual production of more than 50 billion birds. A hen bred for laying can lay over 300 eggs per year. There are numerous cultural references to chickens in folklore, religion, and literature.

A chicken was present in a restaurant within Costa Rica when Lewis Dodgson encounters Dennis Nedry.

Sarr's lab is hidden under a chicken farm. When the Nublar Six and Zayna arrives at the location, Sammy remarks the "cute" chickens.
